questions.q: What does Hamisi wish he had?
questions.explain: Hamisi wishes he had a shirt like the boy he saw in the market.

questions.q: What does Hamisi want his dad to buy?
questions.explain: Hamisi asks his dad to buy a shirt like the one he saw in the market.

questions.q: Why is Hamisi's dad surprised when paying for the uniform?
questions.explain: Hamisi's dad is surprised because there is still money left over to buy a shirt, not enough for the uniform.
